verdict.rationale: An agency that publishes machine-readable open data could plausibly offer an interactive API reference, so this axis applies. However, no such reference or runnable examples are evidenced: every OpenAPI/Swagger candidate path returns 404, and the Webfile transaction surface is reachable only behind an authenticated eSystems login. The keyless SODA query against data.texas.gov is a capability of the Socrata host platform, not a Comptroller-provided interactive API reference, so it earns no credit.
